<thought>From the spectrum we see a series of peaks spaced by ~1 Da (typical 13C pattern) and a clear 2 Da spacing with relatively high intensity (M and M‑2 peaks with a ratio near 0.8 : 1), which is characteristic of chlorine’s 35Cl/37Cl isotopic pair. These patterns allow us to definitively identify carbon and chlorine in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
